RagShortTexts: Alexandria (Alexandreia) was a pivotal fortified settlement, anchoring regional military logistics and urban commerce throughout ancient Mediterranean conflicts.

Variants.Content: Founded by Alexander the Great, Alexandria is the glittering intellectual and commercial jewel of antiquity. Crowned by the monumental Pharos Lighthouse (a Wonder of the Ancient World), the Mouseion and Great Library, and Ptolemaic royal palaces. Harboring thousands of merchant galleys in double ports, it funnels Nile grain and Eastern spices across the Mediterranean.

The ramparts of Alexandria must fly the eagle standard! Whether through engineering circumvallation or direct assault, Rome ensures this fortress serves senatorial order and secures our communication lines!

The markets of Alexandria belong to free maritime trade, not Roman chains! Carthage supports its autonomy against legionary oppression, guaranteeing that Punic gold and spears will reinforce its ramparts!
